Senses.Explanation: A root acknowledgment that the great matter is there, graded against what a speaker still owes or already owns. Juelang Daosheng grants the assembly the whole ten directions and still demands that they know there is the upward whole-lift, Yongjue Yuanxian's lantern-night verse gives the acknowledgment to badgers and calves while the buddhas of the three times get caught and beaten, Danxia Tianran's quoted couplet makes the acknowledgment arrive the moment intent is lifted, Xuedou Chongxian denies it of the old foreigner who missed the one penetration, and Wuyi Yuanlai prescribes the doubt-mass that stops knowing there is a flesh-and-blood body and mind. Hongzhi Zhengjue returns a monk's exchange with the ruling that he must still know there is the turning-around road, Yuanwu Keqin ties seeing the whole-lift and half-lift to those who know there is, Caoshan Benji answers Yunmen that the secret place is exactly why one does not know there is, Dahui Zonggao credits a soldier who knows there is a true teacher and trusts the affair, and Liao'an Qingyu warns that even a faultless world is only a turning word and one must know there is the season of the whole lift.
